accept_criteria: calibration observation gate passed before comparative E10 work
repeatable source-view or fully verified coverage gain; dev oracle >=2 net tests across >=1 task and nonnegative pass@2 is positive screen signal only
one final confirmation only after independent authorization/configuration freeze; CI crossing zero remains inconclusive

calibration_gate_before_E10.failure_action: stop without comparative candidate dispatch, no retry; remaining ceiling is not authority
required: complete exclusive host phase observations with explicit overlap and unknowns
reservations/completions/tokens reconcile; partial verifier never enters pool
default vote/ranking/reset/source evidence parity; record observation overhead

changed_factor: interleaved versus first-occurrence FIFO deferred verification schedule

confirmation.status: not authorized, not independently assigned to E10

controls.fallback: existing separately audited filler; never model-pool credit
controls.parent_hard_watchdog: identical task/session watchdog in both arms; no candidate-only test kill
controls.sampler_and_augmentation: unchanged source full 128-row epoch; generation augment(n=2,seed=2); verification hash(base_key) with startup seed 0
controls.vote_multiplicity: retain every original occurrence/provenance; score reuse only

deployment_claims: research licensing/model/rules statements not independently revalidated for deployment
future_item_implementation: local opt-in implemented; real quality/mechanism unmeasured
kill_criteria: lost votes, changed default method, budget overrun or repeatable verified oracle/pass@2 regression
only raw-returned gain without fully verified mechanism/quality support: stop expansion as no-support or inconclusive

partition.allowed_inputs: train input/output and test input only; no test output, label, score, oracle or difficulty route
partition.confirmation_unlock: one frozen final configuration and one separately authorized comparison across all Stage4 searches
partition.qualification: previously examined public data and unresolved checkpoint exposure; Stage4 decision isolation, never fresh holdout
partition.selection: proposed visible-demo strata with proportional largest-remainder quotas, then task hash within stratum
partition.unit: whole task including every actual test
partition.strata_inputs: training demonstrations only; test inputs retained in full-task identity, never answers
partition.deterministic_allocation: 24 * stratum task count / 120; floor each quota then largest fractional remainders, ties by canonical stratum tuple; no answer-derived minimum quotas
partition.within_stratum_order: SHA256(UTF8(seed) || NUL || canonical_visible_task_digest || NUL || task_id), ascending digest then task_id
partition.dev_order: merge selected whole tasks, same global task-hash order; first six are calibration tasks
partition.freeze_manifest: task IDs, visible full task hashes, source/file/provenance hashes, ordered input test hashes, stratum/quota/seed/method hashes; evaluator never exports strata to solver
partition.prior_E00_method: pure task-hash draft; strata refinement requires controller review before a future manifest freeze

screen.hardware: four distinct BF16 NVIDIA L4s, four independent workers
screen.purpose_of_bounds: planning caps, not throughput estimates or execution permission; bind exact test/material counts in a new plan before approval
screen.status: not_authorized; review and freeze exact new envelope first
screen.coupled_arm_rule: same task, seed, rows, rates, weights, floor, views, caps, parent allocation and watchdog; only verification schedule differs
screen.repeats_rule: two independent same-seed technical repeats per task/arm; failures retained, no best-seed selection or automatic retry
screen.calibration_order: first six interleaved repeat-1 control tasks included in the 96 task-run ceiling; gate before candidate dispatch; no extra calibration runs
screen.allocated_cost_observation: allocated GPU count integrated over observed full session wall, including startup/final output; incomplete observed intervals report proxy and unknown financial total

selected_local_scope: E10 finite offline scheduling implementation and tiny CPU/fake verification only

statistic.paired_task_cluster_bootstrap: recompute sum(correct)/sum(tests) after each whole-task paired draw
statistic.primary: test-micro pass@2 and verified pool oracle; complete actual denominator
statistic.task_macro: separate diagnostic, never substituted for test-micro
statistic.technical_repeats: average paired repeated observations within task; do not count as independent clusters

stop_criteria: stop at workload or session cap, including startup/load/training/guards/export/cleanup
no automatic retry, new identity, quota expansion, confirmation unlock or official submission
unknown license/source/deployment/rules/hardware/resource sufficiency must resolve before any owner execution

assumptions: L4 reference rate USD 0.7992/GPU-hour; actual Kaggle private runtime cash may be zero but quota is finite.
All model/GPU/external operations need a new explicit authorization; these ranges are not spending permission.
Host costs, warm-up, verification, output retention and task length variation must be measured; a cap is a stopping policy, not predicted throughput.
resource_estimates.host_ram_scope: aggregate host RAM planning allowance, actual competition limit unknown

confirmation_if_selected.workload: 96 tasks × selected candidate/baseline 2 arms × 1 run = 192 task-runs; technical repeats not included
confirmation_if_selected.assumptions: 按128step歷史workload作保守區間；64step支線可能較低但未測；confirmation不含在screen表中。

resource_estimates.calibration_note: 24tasks×2arms×2technical repeats=96task-runs。TTT歷史training-only代理5.62GPUh、task-worker代理6.76GPUh；192task-run confirmation約2倍，暖機/retention另計。Phase timers含觀測/guard/IO成本，非純kernel time。

research_acceptance_verbatim: 機制gate：相同cooperative test budget及共同parent hard cap內completed source views或verified unique coverage有可重現增加，並保存完整vote multiplicity、reset/schema不退化。
品質screen：若oracle有>=2test且>=1task淨增、pass@2非負，記positive signal；若無足夠correct outcomes但機制改善，記inconclusive而非整體否定。
只有最終選定configuration進一次locked confirmation；報paired task-cluster CI，跨0則不能稱確立增益。
research_kill_verbatim: 固定排程造成verified oracle或pass@2可重現下降、超資源、丟votes、truth/reset失敗，拒收此配置。
若只有raw candidates增加而verified coverage/oracle沒有訊號，停止擴大並標no-support/inconclusive；不追加未批准算力。

local_validation_claims.fake_clock: admission/mechanism only; cannot establish GPU gain or kernel preemption
local_validation_claims.tiny_CPU: source semantics, NLL/DFS transcript replay and matched synthetic 128-step epoch only; no real SFT139 benchmark

remaining_freeze_fields: exact canonical visible source/task manifest and all actual tests
row/token/LR/model/code/outbound hashes and technical repeat order
common task/session parent hardcaps and resources/quota/session sufficiency
action-time rules, source/model license and checkpoint exposure review
separate owner real screen authorization; no existing saved identity reuse
one final chosen configuration and separately authorized public development confirmation budget
